title: Nancy Pelosi calls female US president in her lifetime unlikely: ‘Marble ceiling’
summary: Former House speaker, 85, expects woman to assume Oval Office this generation but concedes she may not live to see it Nancy Pelosi , the outgoing congresswoman and former House speaker, has conceded that she may not see a woman be elected US president in her lifetime. The California Democrat said as much in a USA Today interview published on Sunday with her retirement looming after four decades in Congress – and invoked a turn of phrase referring to a metaphorical barrier impeding advancement in a profession that often confronts women and racial minorities.
